name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: mangacn's own Date Picker (shadcn documents it as a recipe, not an item): DatePicker (one date) and DateRangePicker (from / to), built on the manga Popover and Calendar. The trigger is a field like the Select trigger: 2px ink line, a drawn calendar mark, the placeholder in the same ink (italic, never grey), the date formatted with date-fns. Hover thickens the line, focus is ink / paper / ink, the line goes to 3px while open, disabled is dashed with a tone frame, aria-invalid adds the accent line and a "!" mark. The calendar opens in a speech bubble with a tail toward the trigger and pops in; choosing a day closes it (single). The range picker shows two months from 640px and one on phones, so the bubble fits a 360px screen. Works with Radix and Base UI (the trigger only gets a className).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/date-picker". It uses the manga Popover and Calendar (installed with it), so Radix and Base UI both work. Pass calendarProps for the caption dropdowns (captionLayout="dropdown" with startMonth / endMonth), disabled days or a locale. className replaces the default trigger width (w-72, w-80 for the range).

meta.tagline: An ink field that opens a calendar in a speech bubble.
meta.usage:
import { DatePicker, DateRangePicker } from "@/components/ui/manga/date-picker"

<DatePicker placeholder="Release day" onValueChange={(date) => console.log(date)} />
<DateRangePicker placeholder="Trip dates" />

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new date or range (undefined when cleared).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the same ink, italic, while nothing is chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dashed line and tone frame; the calendar cannot open.

props.name: formatString
props.description: date-fns format of each date in the trigger.

props.name: calendarProps
props.description: Extra Calendar props: captionLayout, startMonth, endMonth, disabled days, locale…

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: The error look: accent line and a "!" mark.

props.name: datePickerTriggerClassName
props.description: The trigger look, for a static twin or a trigger of your own.
